Please discuss about / the proposal / with the finance team.

The children / was playing / in the park.

questions.q: According to the passage, what new services do libraries offer?

questions.p: Libraries are quietly reinventing themselves. Once storehouses of books, many now offer internet access, coding clubs, job-search help and spaces for community meetings. In small towns, the public library may be the only place where a student can study in peace or a job-seeker can print an application. Cutting library budgets may save little money but costs communities a great deal.

questions.q:

Equality of opportunity in matters of public employment
Council of Ministers to aid and advise the Governor

Power of Parliament to legislate for two or more States by consent

o: Adjudication of disputes relating to waters of inter-State rivers
Taxes not to be imposed save by authority of law
Protection of life and personal liberty

questions.q: 'Black money' refers to:
o: Income not disclosed to tax authorities
questions.x: Demonetisation (2016) of ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes was aimed partly at black money.

questions.q: As per Census 2011, India's literacy rate was approximately:
questions.x: Correct answer: 74%. Kerala had the highest literacy rate and Bihar the lowest.

questions.q: 'Bull market' refers to a market in which prices are:
questions.x: Correct answer: Rising or expected to rise. A bear market has falling prices.

questions.q: Minimum Support Prices for crops are announced by the Government on the recommendation of the:

questions.x: Correct answer: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices. CACP recommends MSPs for 22 mandated crops plus FRP for sugarcane.

questions.q: SEBI is headquartered in:
questions.x: Correct answer: Mumbai. Its chairperson as of 2025 is Tuhin Kanta Pandey.

questions.q: The 'National Monetisation Pipeline' (2021) refers to:

questions.q: The primary sector of an economy includes:
questions.x: Correct answer: Agriculture, forestry, fishing and mining. Secondary = manufacturing/construction; tertiary = services.

questions.q: If India's exports of goods are $440 billion and imports $680 billion, the merchandise trade deficit is:
questions.x: Correct answer: $240 billion. Deficit = imports − exports.

questions.q: A consumer price index rose from 200.8 to 208.8 over a year. The inflation rate (rounded to one decimal) is:
questions.x: Inflation = (New index − Old index)/Old index × 100 = (208.8 − 200.8)/200.8 × 100 ≈ 4%.

questions.q: Under the Union Budget 2025–26, under the new tax regime individuals with income up to what amount effectively pay no income tax (excluding special-rate income)?
questions.x: A higher rebate made income up to ₹12 lakh tax-free; salaried taxpayers get ₹12.75 lakh with the standard deduction.

questions.q: A business has total assets of ₹7,75,000 and outside liabilities of ₹7,60,000. Its capital (owner's equity) is:
questions.x: Assets = Liabilities + Capital → Capital = 7,75,000 − 7,60,000 = ₹15,000.

questions.q: Credit purchases of goods are recorded in the:
questions.x: Cash purchases go to the cash book; credit purchases of goods to the purchases book.

questions.q: Purchases during a month: 1st — 100 units @ ₹14; 10th — 300 units @ ₹16; 20th — 200 units @ ₹18. 300 units were issued on the 25th. Value of closing stock under FIFO is:
questions.x: Under FIFO the earliest units are issued first, so the 300 units left come from the latest purchases: 200 × ₹18 + 100 × ₹16 = ₹5,200.

questions.q: Fixed costs are ₹67,000, selling price is ₹90 per unit and variable cost is ₹80 per unit. The break-even point in units is:
questions.x:
Contribution per unit = 90 − 80 = ₹10.
BEP (units) = Fixed cost / Contribution per unit = 67,000 / 10 = 6,700 units.

questions.q: The current ratio of a company is 2 : 1 and its working capital is ₹75,000. Its current assets amount to:
questions.x:
Let current liabilities = x. Then current assets = 2x and working capital = 2x − x = 1x.
1x = 75,000 → x = ₹75,000.
Current assets = 2 × 75,000 = ₹1,50,000.

questions.q: Test checking in auditing refers to:
o: Examining a sample of transactions rather than all
questions.x: Correct answer: Examining a sample of transactions rather than all. Sampling is used when internal controls are reliable.

questions.q: The cash book of a firm shows a debit (bank) balance of ₹50,000. Cheques issued but not yet presented: ₹2,000; cheques deposited but not yet credited: ₹4,000. The balance as per the pass book is:
questions.x:
Start with cash book balance ₹50,000.
+ Cheques issued not presented (bank has not yet paid) 2,000
− Cheques deposited not credited 4,000
Pass book balance = ₹48,000.

questions.q: Prime cost is the sum of:
o: Direct materials, direct labour and direct expenses
questions.x: Correct answer: Direct materials, direct labour and direct expenses. Prime cost + factory overheads = works cost.

questions.q: The profits of a firm for the last 3 years were ₹23,000, ₹51,000, ₹72,000. Goodwill is to be valued at 2 years' purchase of the average profit. Goodwill is:

Consider the following statements about the cash book:
1. It records both cash receipts and payments.
2. A cash book can never show a credit balance in the cash column.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.x:
Statement 1 is correct; Statement 2 is correct.
Cash in hand cannot be negative; the bank column may show a credit balance (overdraft).

questions.q: The account opened on admission or retirement to record changes in the values of assets and liabilities is the:
o: Revaluation account (profit and loss adjustment account)
questions.x: Correct answer: Revaluation account (profit and loss adjustment account). Revaluation profit/loss is shared by old partners in the old ratio.

questions.q: Machinery costing ₹1,00,000 is depreciated at 25% per annum on the Written Down Value method. Its book value at the end of 2 years will be:
questions.x:
WDV: depreciation each year is charged on the opening book value.
Book value = Cost × (1 − r)ⁿ = 1,00,000 × (0.75)^2 = ₹56,250.
(SLM at the same rate would give ₹50,000.)

questions.q: Rent paid in cash is recorded as:
o: Rent A/c Dr. To Cash A/c
Cash A/c Dr. To Rent A/c
Landlord A/c Dr. To Cash A/c
Rent A/c Dr. To Capital A/c
questions.x: Rent is an expense (nominal — debit expenses); cash goes out (real — credit).

questions.q: Bonus shares are issued to existing shareholders:
o: Free of cost by capitalising reserves
questions.x: Bonus issue converts reserves into share capital without changing net worth.

questions.q: Under the OSH Code, a 'hazardous process' is one that, if not controlled, could:
o: Reduce the profit of the company
Cause material impairment to the health of persons engaged or pollute the environment
questions.x: Hazardous process relates to processes listed in the schedule where raw materials, products or wastes could impair health or cause environmental pollution.

questions.q: The Code on Wages provisions on timely payment and authorised deductions apply to:
o: All employees, irrespective of their wage level
Only employees earning up to ₹24,000 a month
questions.x: Unlike the Payment of Wages Act (which applied only up to a wage ceiling), the Code's payment provisions cover all employees.

questions.q: How many central labour laws were consolidated into the four Labour Codes that came into force on 21 November 2025?
questions.x: The four Codes amalgamate 29 central labour laws: 4 in the Code on Wages, 3 in the Industrial Relations Code, 9 in the Code on Social Security and 13 in the OSH Code.

questions.q: The All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC), founded in 1920, had as its first president:
questions.x: AITUC was founded in Bombay on 31 October 1920; Lala Lajpat Rai was president and Dewan Chaman Lall general secretary (N. M. Joshi was a key founder).

questions.q: Under the IR Code, a Works Committee may be required in an industrial establishment with:
questions.x: Section 3 retains Works Committees for establishments employing 100 or more workers, to promote amity and good relations.

questions.q: Under the IR Code, a worker dismissed after a domestic inquiry feels the punishment is excessive. The Industrial Tribunal can:
o: Set aside the dismissal and award a lesser punishment if the facts justify it
Only order reinstatement with full back wages
questions.x: The power earlier in Section 11A of the ID Act is retained: the Tribunal can modify punishment and grant appropriate relief.

questions.q: V. V. Giri National Labour Institute, a premier institute for labour research and training, is located at:
questions.x: Established in 1974 and named after V. V. Giri in 1995, it is located in Noida (Uttar Pradesh).

questions.q: Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) is defined as the percentage of:
o: Persons in the labour force (employed + unemployed seeking work) in the population
Employed persons in the labour force
questions.x: LFPR = labour force / population × 100. WPR = employed / population × 100. UR = unemployed / labour force × 100.

questions.q: The Sales Promotion Employees (Conditions of Service) Act, 1976 primarily extended labour protections to:
o: Medical representatives and other sales promotion staff
questions.x: It applied to sales promotion employees in pharmaceutical and notified industries; it is now part of the OSH Code.

questions.q: J. Stacy Adams' equity theory suggests that employees are motivated by:
o: Fairness of their input–outcome ratio compared with others
questions.x: Employees compare their output/input ratio with referents; perceived inequity leads to tension and corrective action.

questions.q: Article 21A, providing free and compulsory education to children aged 6–14, was inserted by which amendment?
questions.x: The 86th Amendment (2002) inserted Article 21A, amended Article 45 and added a fundamental duty (51A(k)).

questions.q: DGFASLI, which advises on factory safety and runs labour institutes, is headquartered in:
questions.x: The Directorate General Factory Advice Service and Labour Institutes is based in Mumbai with regional labour institutes elsewhere.

questions.q: The Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017 increased paid maternity leave from 12 weeks to:
questions.x: The 2017 amendment raised maternity benefit to 26 weeks for the first two children.

questions.q: A 'badli' worker in Indian industry is:
o: A worker employed in place of a permanent worker who is temporarily absent
questions.x: Badli (substitute) workers replace absent permanent workers; on completing a year of continuous service they get retrenchment benefits.

questions.q: What makes the ILO unique among UN agencies?
o: Its tripartite structure of governments, employers and workers
It is funded entirely by trade unions
Its decisions are binding on all countries automatically
questions.x: Each member state is represented by government, employer and worker delegates with independent votes.

questions.q: A 'Voluntary Retirement Scheme' (VRS) is used by organisations to:
o: Reduce surplus staff by offering incentives for early retirement
questions.x: VRS, sometimes called a 'golden handshake', is a humane way of right-sizing.

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of social insurance in India?
questions.x: Correct answer: Employees' State Insurance. ESI is a contribution-based social insurance scheme.

questions.q: EPS pension is payable to a member for:
o: Life, and thereafter to the family as family pension
questions.x: Member pension is lifelong; widow/children's pension follows on death.

questions.q: The initial EPF contribution rate when the scheme began in 1952 was:
questions.x: Both employer and employee contributed 6.25% initially.

questions.q: Form 31, Form 19 and Form 10C under EPF are used respectively for:
o: Advance (partial withdrawal), final PF settlement, and pension withdrawal benefit/scheme certificate
questions.x: Form 31 (advance), Form 19 (PF final settlement) and Form 10C (EPS withdrawal benefit/scheme certificate).

questions.q: An employee retires after 14 years of continuous service. Last drawn monthly wages (basic + DA) are ₹34,000. Gratuity payable under the statutory formula (non-seasonal establishment) is:
questions.x:
Gratuity = 15/26 × last drawn wages × completed years of service.
= 15/26 × 34,000 × 14 = ₹2,74,615 (well within the ₹20 lakh ceiling).
The divisor 26 reflects working days in a month.

questions.q: EPF final settlement on retirement is available after the member attains the age of:
questions.x: Retirement after 55 years entitles full withdrawal; EPS pension is payable from 58.

questions.q: ESIC Foundation Day is observed on:
questions.x: The ESI Scheme was inaugurated at Kanpur on 24 February 1952.

questions.q: If an employer delays EPF remittance by three months, the Section 14B damages rate applicable is:
questions.x: Delay of 2–4 months attracts damages at 10% per annum (in addition to 12% interest under 7Q).

questions.q: In which year was the EPF contribution rate raised to 12% for most establishments?
questions.x: The rate rose from 6.25% (1952) to 8%, then 10% and to 12% (from 1997) for most industries.

questions.q: In October 2024, PM-JAY coverage was extended to:
o: All senior citizens aged 70 and above, irrespective of income
questions.x: Senior citizens aged 70+ receive the 'Ayushman Vay Vandana' card with cover up to ₹5 lakh (a separate top-up for families already covered).

questions.q: An eligible employee earns ₹7,500 per month. The notified minimum wage for the employment is ₹8,000 per month. If the establishment declares bonus at 8.33%, the annual bonus payable is (statutory computation):
questions.x:
For computing bonus, salary is capped at ₹7,000 or the minimum wage, whichever is higher: max(7,000, 8,000) = ₹8,000.
Salary for computation = min(7,500, 8,000) = ₹7,500.
Annual bonus = 7,500 × 12 × 8.33% = ₹7,497. Bonus must lie between 8.33% and 20%.

questions.q: Janani Suraksha Yojana, a safe-motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission, mainly provides:
o: Cash assistance to promote institutional delivery
questions.x: JSY (2005) gives conditional cash transfers for institutional deliveries, especially among poor women.

questions.q: Which of the following is volatile memory?
questions.x: RAM loses its contents when power is switched off.

questions.q: An electric generator works on the principle of:
questions.x: Faraday discovered electromagnetic induction.

questions.q: A barometer is used to measure:
questions.x: Barometer: Atmospheric pressure.

questions.q: Which abbreviation stands for 'Solid State Drive'?
questions.x: Solid State Drive is abbreviated as SSD.

questions.q: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
questions.x: Correct answer: Mercury. Bromine is the non-metal that is liquid at room temperature.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): Cloud storage allows access to files from any device with internet.
Reason (R): Cloud storage saves files only on the local hard disk.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: A is true but R is false. R is false — cloud storage keeps files on remote servers.

questions.q: The causative agent of leprosy is:
o: Wuchereria bancrofti (nematode worm, spread by Culex mosquitoes)
questions.x: Leprosy: Mycobacterium leprae (bacterium).

questions.q: Periodic table of elements is credited to:
questions.x: Periodic table of elements: Dmitri Mendeleev.

questions.q: The 'Joule' is the SI unit of:
questions.x: Joule measures energy.

questions.q: The basic structural and functional unit of life is the:
questions.x: Robert Hooke coined the term 'cell' in 1665.

questions.q: In computing, 'IoT' stands for:
questions.x: IoT = Internet of Things.

questions.q: Why do we see a mirage in deserts on hot days?
o: Total internal reflection of light due to hot, less dense air near the ground
questions.x: Correct answer: Total internal reflection of light due to hot, less dense air near the ground. Layers of air with different refractive indices bend light.

questions.q: A rectangular plot measures 19 m by 16 m. What is the cost of fencing it at ₹20 per metre?
The average age of 21 trainees in a batch is 11 years. When the instructor's age is also included, the average rises by 0.5 years. The instructor's age is:
questions.x:
Total of trainees = 21 × 11 = 231.
With instructor: 22 × 11.5 = 253.
Instructor = 253 − 231 = 22 years.

questions.q:
Production of a fertiliser unit (thousand tonnes) over five years — 2019: 300  |  2020: 280  |  2021: 250  |  2022: 245  |  2023: 290.
What is the average per year over the five years?
What is the unit digit of 18^31?
questions.x:
Unit digit depends only on 8. Powers of 8 repeat with cycle 4: 8, 4, 2, 6.
31 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 3 → use position 3 of the cycle → 2.

questions.q: Three sirens sound at intervals of 18, 10, 16 seconds respectively. If they start together, after how long will they next coincide?
questions.x:
They coincide after LCM(18, 10, 16) seconds.
LCM = 720 s = 12 min.

questions.q: The marks of students are: 19, 17, 19, 34, 50, 40, 55, 17, 91. Their arithmetic mean is:
questions.x: Sum = 342; number of values = 9. Mean = 342/9 = 38.

questions.q: A trader buys a bicycle for ₹1,400 and sells it for ₹1,750. His profit per cent is:
questions.x:
Profit = SP − CP = ₹1,750 − ₹1,400 = ₹350.
Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100 = (350 / 1,400) × 100 = 25%.
(Profit % is always on cost price, not on selling price.)

questions.q: Two inlet pipes can fill an overhead tank in 10 hours and 20 hours respectively, while an outlet pipe can empty the full tank in 12 hours. If all three are opened together on an empty tank, it will be full in:
questions.x:
Take tank capacity = LCM(10, 20, 12) = 60 units.
Rates: +6, +3, −5 units/hour → net 4 units/hour.
Time = 60 / 4 = 15 hours.

questions.q: In what ratio must sugar costing ₹100 per kg be mixed with sugar costing ₹220 per kg so that the mixture is worth ₹147 per kg?
questions.x:
Alligation: (dearer − mean) : (mean − cheaper) = (220 − 147) : (147 − 100) = 73 : 47 = 73 : 47.
This is cheaper : dearer.

questions.q: In how many different ways can the letters of the word 'CONTRACT' be arranged?
questions.x:
The word has 8 letters; C appears 2 times, T appears 2 times.
Arrangements = 8! / (2! × 2!) = 40,320 / 4 = 10,080.

questions.q: Two fair dice are thrown together. What is the probability that the sum of the numbers shown is 5?
What simple interest will ₹5,500 earn in 5 years at 8% per annum?
Find the odd one out among 199, 73, 152 and 149.
questions.x: 149, 199, 73 are all prime numbers; 152 is not. Hence 152 is the odd one out.

questions.q: Find the compound interest on ₹13,000 for 2 years at 4% per annum, compounded annually.
questions.x:
Amount = P(1 + R/100)² = 13,000 × (1.04)² = ₹14,060.80.
CI = Amount − P = ₹1,060.80.
Check: SI for 2 years = ₹1,040; CI exceeds it by P(R/100)² = ₹20.80.
